method.trigger_eval: Run prompts in fresh sessions when possible. Record which skill should trigger and whether another skill would be a better primary route.
method.artifact_eval: Inspect produced files with the skill's bundled scripts and compare outputs to assertions.
method.forward_test: For independent validation, give only the skill path, prompt, and files from work/artifact-skills/forward-test-prompts.json to a fresh agent. Do not include expected_skill, assertions, or suspected fixes.
